title: sorbus aucuparia var. lanuginosa
intro: Sorbus aucuparia var. lanuginosa, commonly known as Downy Whitebeam, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is prized for its potential health benefits, including the ability to support immune function and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The Downy Whitebeam is believed to exert therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
